markdown.markdown:
Reproducible Academic CV — Aleem Ashraf
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Render with the RStudio "Render" button, or from a terminal:

     quarto render cv.qmd

 Everything visible in the CV is pulled programmatically from the three
 source files in data/ (cv_data.xlsx, profile.yml, my_publications.bib).
 The R code that reads, filters and formats each section lives in R/cv.R;
 this document only wires the sections together in order.

 NOTE: keep all prose inside HTML comments like this one. The CV is emitted
 as raw Typst through the chunks below, and ordinary Markdown outside them
 would be styled by Quarto's default template instead of the CV template.
============================================================================
-->

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: setup

## 1. Project setup ----------------------------------------------------------
if (!dir.exists("data"))
  stop("Render this file from the project root ",
       "(open 'academic-cv-quarto' as an RStudio project first).")
source("R/cv.R")

## 2. Configuration ----------------------------------------------------------
# Every tunable knob of the pipeline. Lowering a number relaxes the filter 
# (e.g., setting to 8 includes items ranked 8, 9, and 10).
cfg <- cv_config(
  prio_experience     = 8L,   # Academic Experience threshold
  prio_courses        = 9L,   # Delivered Courses threshold
  prio_supervision    = 7L,   # Research Supervision threshold
  prio_services       = 7L,   # Academic Services threshold
  prio_qualifications = 10L,  # Qualifications threshold
  prio_ce             = 10L,  # Continuous Education threshold
  prio_profdev        = 7L,   # Professional Development threshold
  
  # --- 2. Typography & Sizing ---
  # Must match the exact font name installed on your Windows system
  font_family         = "Corbel", 
  font_size           = "10pt",  # Increase to "11pt" if a specific employer prefers larger text
  author_font_size    = "25pt",  # Scales your name at the very top of the page
  
  # --- 3. Content Toggles ---
  # Set to FALSE to instantly strip all student names from your supervision section
  show_supervisees    = TRUE,    
  
  # --- 4. Publication Controls ---
  # Customize the text that appears in small caps next to "Publications"
  pub_legend          = "P = Published, S = Submitted",
  
  # Manually force the status of specific BibTeX entries regardless of their type
  # Format: c(bib_key = "Status")
  pub_status_override = c(
    # Example: ashraf_conformity_2026 = "UPR", 
    # Example: ashraf_qmers_2025 = "P"
  )
)

## 3. Load all sources -------------------------------------------------------
cv <- cv_load("data", cfg)
```

```{r}
#| label: header
#| output: asis
# Imports the pro-academic-cv template and prints the header (name, title,
# contact links with icons, location) plus the subsection-heading style.
cat_typst(header_block(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: profile
#| output: asis
# "Professional Profile": the profile paragraph plus research interests,
# methodological expertise and software, pulled from profile.yml.
cat_typst(section_profile(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: experience
#| output: asis
# "Academic Experience": organizations (priority == 10 in `appointments`)
# with every designation and its date range, plus the organization overview.
cat_typst(section_experience(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: courses
#| output: asis
# "Delivered Courses": courses with priority > 7, enriched with section
# counts, years and student totals computed from the `teaching` sheet.
cat_typst(section_courses(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: supervision
#| output: asis
# "Research Supervision": supervised projects with priority > 7, newest first.
cat_typst(section_supervision(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: services
#| output: asis
# "Academic Services": services with priority > 7, with the host organization.
cat_typst(section_services(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: qualifications
#| output: asis
# "Academic Qualifications": degrees with priority == 10, newest first
# (a degree still in progress shows its status instead of a completion year).
cat_typst(section_qualifications(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: publications
#| output: asis
# "Publications": every entry of my_publications.bib, auto-classified as
# P = Published or UPR = Under peer review (legend shown on the heading).
cat_typst(section_publications(cv, cfg))
```

```{r}
#| label: professional-development
#| output: asis
# "Research & Professional Development" with the "Continuous Education"
# subsection (priority == 10, newest first, credential links as icons).
cat_typst(section_profdev(cv, cfg))
```
